title: Model Selection & Evaluation
description: Choose the right model for your use case and evaluate LLM outputs effectively.

data.text: Choose models based on task requirements, cost, latency, and quality. Evaluate outputs with automated metrics and human evaluation for production systems.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Smaller models are faster and cheaper for simple tasks
Larger models perform better on complex reasoning
Evaluate with automated metrics and human review
Consider latency, cost, and quality tradeoffs
Fine-tune smaller models for specific tasks
data.takeaway: Model selection is a tradeoff between cost, latency, and quality. Start with smaller models and scale up only when needed. Evaluate thoroughly before production deployment.
